title: ClearNav: Perception-Aligned Quadrotor Flight Using Differential-Physics
abstract: arXiv:2610.17419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous quadrotor flight in cluttered environment is an key capability for tasks like inspection and search. Navigation policies trained in simulation and transferred to hardware can fly at high speed in open space, but they can still collide as obstacle clearance shrinks. We attribute most of these collisions to a single mechanism, namely motion in directions the onboard camera does not observe. Heading that is not aligned with the direction of travel and lateral excursion during obstacle avoidance both carry the vehicle toward obstacles outside its field of view. We introduce ClearNav, a navigation policy trained with two reward terms that constrain motion to the observed direction, a forward-looking heading target and a penalty on lateral velocity. translated_title: ClearNav：基于微分物理的感知对齐四旋翼飞行
translated_abstract: 在杂乱环境中实现自主四旋翼飞行是巡检和搜索等任务的一项关键能力。在仿真中训练并迁移到硬件的导航策略能够在开阔空间中高速飞行，但随着障碍物间隙的缩小，它们仍可能发生碰撞。我们将这些碰撞中的大多数归因于一个单一机制，即沿机载摄像头未观测方向的运动。朝向与行进方向不一致，以及避障过程中产生的横向偏移，都会使飞行器朝向其视野之外的障碍物移动。我们提出了ClearNav，这是一种通过两个奖励项进行训练的导航策略，用于将运动约束在被观测的方向上：一个前视朝向目标和一个横向速度惩罚项。第三个惩罚项对障碍物附近的速度进行约束，使得进入视野的障碍物仍处于可避让范围内。在仿真中，跨越18个留出测试场景，每个场景进行2304次配对飞行实验……
tldr: 提出ClearNav导航策略，通过前视朝向目标、横向速度惩罚和近障碍物减速惩罚三项奖励约束，将四旋翼运动始终限制在机载摄像头可观测的方向内，从而大幅减少盲区碰撞。
en_tdlr: ClearNav aligns quadrotor motion with the camera's field of view using reward terms—a forward-looking heading target, a lateral velocity penalty, and a speed penalty near obstacles—significantly reducing collisions with unseen obstacles in cluttered environments.
